verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (a trademark extranet and AI review tools), so a bulk-operations question is fair to ask. No evidence documents a user performing bulk actions across many items at once. Portfolio-level reporting and docket management, and automated contract-provision extraction for due diligence, are adjacent features rather than a documented bulk-operation capability. No API or OpenAPI surface exists for programmatic batch actions either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
